8471214.c: Ovechkin (lower body) was a full participant in Thursday's practice and has a chance to play in Friday's preseason game against the Bruins, per Tom Gulitti.

8473419.c: Marchand (lower body) is expected to spend October rehabbing, per Panthers TV Rinkside Reporter Katie Engleson on Thursday.

8475168.c: Duchene will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Wild, Stars TV host Brien Rea reports.

8475760.c: The Devils announced Thursday that Bjugstad underwent successful surgery to repair a torn left pectoral muscle last week and will be sidelined for approximately 4-6 months.

8476278.c: Blackwell is dealing with a lower-body injury but should return before Opening Night, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports Monday.

8477426.c: Head coach Jim Hiller said Thursday that Paul (undisclosed) is considered day-to-day, David Alter of The Hockey News reports.

8477942.c: Fiala (lower leg fracture) is at least three weeks away from being ready to play, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

8477946.c: Larkin (upper body) participated in Wednesday's practice session but won't play in Thursday's preseason matchup against the Sabres, Ted Kulfan of The Detroit News reports.

8477967.c: Demko (hip) has been designated for injured reserve, per the NHL media site Thursday.

8477998.c: Foegele (undisclosed) won't appear in either of the Senators' split-squad preseason games against Toronto on Wednesday, Claire Hanna of TSN reports.

8478057.c: Joshua is dealing with a core muscle injury and remains day-to-day, Luke Fox of Sportsnet reports Wednesday.

8478873.c: Terry (hip) is slated to be out for another 2-3 months, according to Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune on Saturday.

8479325.c: McAvoy logged an even-strength goal on three shots and four PIM in a game-high 28:35 of ice time during Sunday's 3-2 shootout win over the Capitals in preseason play.

8479981.c: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.

8480069.c: Makar (lower body) was a full participant in Tuesday's training camp session and could suit up for one of Colorado's upcoming preseason games, per Evan Rawal of the Denver Gazette.

8480356.c: Keyser has suffered a long-term upper-body injury, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports Thursday.

8480801.c: Tkachuk (undisclosed) is considered day-to-day, Jameson Olive of the Panthers' official site reports Wednesday.

8480831.c: Regula (undisclosed) is expected to skate during training camp but won't participate in any preseason games, Jason Gregor of Sports 1440 Edmonton reports Wednesday.

8481563.c: Helleson (lower body) will be out for at least one week, but he could be available for the start of the regular season, Zach Cavanagh of The Sporting Tribune reports.

8482087.c: The Canadiens announced Wednesday that Guhle is recovering from a minor surgery to his adductor muscle that he underwent over the summer, and he's expected to return in 4-5 weeks.

8482093.c: Jarvis (shoulder) was on the ice for practice Thursday, Ryan Henkel of The Hockey News reports.

8482245.c: Zub (knee) isn't expected to be ready for Ottawa's season opener in Toronto on Oct. 3, per TSN 1200 Ottawa on Wednesday.

8482803.c: Head coach Lindy Ruff said Wednesday that Zellweger has entered the concussion protocol, Paul Hamilton of WGR Sports Radio 550 reports.

8483472.c: Lamoureux is expected to miss some time due to his upper-body injury, per Brogan Houston of the Deseret News on Wednesday.

8483481.c: Lund (upper body) is expected to miss around a month, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports Thursday.

8483509.c: Salin is dealing with an undisclosed injury, Zach Dooley of the Kings' official site reports Thursday.

8483669.c: Sykora (lower body) is expected to be out of action for 4-5 months, Colin Stephenson of Newsday reports Wednesday.

8483808.c: Kuzmenko is returning to Russia following the death of his father, the team announced Thursday.

8484144.c: Head coach Jeff Blashill said Wednesday that Bedard (shoulder) isn't yet close to joining the Blackhawks for practice, Scott Powers of The Athletic reports.

8484200.c: Musty will be out long-term due to his upper-body injury, Curtis Pashelka of The San Jose Mercury News reports Thursday.

8484984.c: Demidov (foot) was deemed day-to-day, but is not expected to miss the start of the regular season, per Stu Cowan of The Montreal Gazette.

8485362.c: Bear (upper body) is expected to be out for the next seven to 10 days, per Max Bultman of The Athletic.

8485414.c: The Penguins announced Thursday that Kindel (lower body) is undergoing further testing and is considered week-to-week, Josh Yohe of The Athletic reports.

tx.text: Waived for the purpose of assignment to Iowa (AHL) Ds Matt Kiersted, Carson Lambos, and Roman Schmidt and Fs Caedan Bankier, Dylan Gambrell, Justin Kirkland, Tyler Pitlick, and Mason Shaw. Assigned Ds Ben Dexheimer and Viking Gustafsson Nyberg and Fs Jagger Joshua, Hunter Haight, Riley Heidt, Rasmus Kumpulainen, and Rieger Lorenz to Iowa.
Signed F Adam Fantilli to a six-year contract extension.
Assigned Fs Ozzy Wiesblatt, Chase Bradley, David Edstrom, Joakim Kemell, Jake Lucchini and Ben Strinden, D Daniel Nieminen and G Isak Posch to Milwaukee (AHL).
Assigned D Matt Basgall and Konnor Smith, G Damian Clara and Fs Coulson Pitre, Yegor Sidorov and Herman Traff to San Diego (AHL).

Assigned Fs Ty Mueller, Riley Patterson, Ilya Safonov and Chase Wouters, Ds Kirill Kudryavtsev and Sawyer Mynio to Abbotsford (AHL). Loaned F Ben Berard and D Isaac Belliveau to Abbotsford. Waived for the purpose of assignment to Abbotsford F Trey Fix-Wolansky and Ds Cole Clayton and Jimmy Schuldt.
Assigned Ds Saige Weinstein, Domenick Fensore and Christian Wolanin to Colorado (AHL).

Assigned Fs Brayden Edwards, Max Graham, Jack Horbach, Hugh McGing, Mark Senden, Tiernan Shoudy and Daniel Russell, Ds Finn Harding and Daniel Laatsch and G Taylor Gauthier to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton (AHL). Placed F Melvin Fernstrom and G Gabriel D'Aigle on injured reserve. Waived for the purpose of assignment to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton D Phil Kemp.
Loaned Fs Zach Aston-Reese, Nolan Foote, Danila Klimovich and Jack Studnicka and D Cam Dineen to Lehigh Valley (AHL).
Assigned Gs Spencer Martin and Callum Tung and Fs Jacob Battaglia, Brody Lamb, and Dylan Roobroeck to Hartford (AHL).
Loaned D Jack Anderson, Fs Dylan Hryckowian, Artem Shlaine and Emil Hemming and G Arno Tiefensee to Texas (AHL).

Waived for the purpose of assignment to Abbotsford (AHL) Fs Martin Chromia, Cole Guttman, Lane Pederson and Francesco Pinelli and D Joe Hicketts. Loaned Fs Aatu Jamsen and Koehn Ziemmer, Ds Angus Booth, Kirill Kirsanov and Jared Woolley to Ontario. Placed F Jan Jenik and D Jakub Dvorak on injured reserve.

Agreed to terms with F Oliver Moore on a five-year contract extension. Loaned Fs Jiri felcman, Martin Misiak and Marek Vanacker and D Dylan Anhorn to Rockford (AHL). Assigned F Brett Seney to Rockford.
Assigned G Simon Zajicek to Providence (AHL).
Placed D Jaycob Megna, D Adam Ginning, D Joe Fleming, C Jakub Demek and D Jeremy Davies on waivers.
Placed RW Ozzy Wiesblatt on waivers.
Placed RW Trey Fix-Wolansky on waivers.
Placed G Jonas Johansson on waivers.
Placed RW Ethan Cardwell, D Libor Hajek and LW Tye Felhaber on waivers.
Placed D Domenick Fensore and D Christian Wolanin on waivers.
Placed G Taylor Gauthier on waivers for the purpose of reassignment to the minors.
Placed F Ludwig Persson on waivers for the purpose of assignment to Hershey (AHL).
Placed F Justin Dowling and D Urho Vaakanainen on waivers.
Loaned G Arno Tiefensee to Texas (AHL).
Placed F Jon-Randall Avon, F John Hayden, F Logan Morrison and G Victor Ostman on waivers.
Placed D Derrick Pouliot on waivers.

rw.name: Alex Lyon
rw.head: Hurt in Thursday's game
rw.blurb: Lyon sustained an upper-body injury in the first period of Thursday's preseason game against the Red Wings, Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News reports.

rw.name: Devin Cooley
rw.head: Starting in Seattle
rw.blurb: Cooley will tend the twine on the road in Thursday's preseason game versus the Kraken, per the NHL media site.

rw.name: Sebastian Cossa
rw.head: Expected to start Thursday
rw.blurb: Cossa is slated to start in Thursday's preseason road game against Vegas, per Jesse Granger of The Athletic.

rw.name: Ville Husso
rw.head: Set to start
rw.blurb: Husso will protect the road goal in Thursday's preseason game versus the Sharks, Max Miller of NHL.com reports.

rw.name: Philipp Grubauer
rw.head: Getting start Thursday
rw.blurb: Grubauer will protect the home goal Thursday in a preseason game versus the Flames, per Sound of Hockey.

rw.name: Tristan Jarry
rw.head: Getting start in road game
rw.blurb: Jarry will protect the road goal in Thursday's preseason game versus the Canucks, per the NHL media site.

rw.name: Pheonix Copley
rw.head: Still on NHL roster
rw.blurb: Copley successfully cleared waivers Thursday, but he's still on Columbus' roster.

rw.name: Adam Fantilli
rw.head: Ends contract dispute
rw.blurb: Fantilli agreed to terms on a six-year, $82.5 million contract with Columbus on Thursday, Elliotte Friedman of Sportsnet reports.

rw.name: Leevi Merilainen
rw.head: Lands on waivers
rw.blurb: Merilainen was put on waivers by Ottawa on Thursday, per Renaud Lavoie of TVA Sports.

rw.name: Adin Hill
rw.head: Drawing start Thursday
rw.blurb: Hill was the first goalie off during Thursday's morning skate, Jesse Granger of The Athletic reports, indicating that he'll draw the preseason start at home against Utah.

rw.name: Jake Oettinger
rw.head: Unavailable for preseason finale
rw.blurb: Oettinger (lower body) won't suit up for Friday's preseason finale on the road against Minnesota, Robert Tiffin of NHL.com reports.

rw.name: Sergei Murashov
rw.head: Starting in Columbus
rw.blurb: Murashov will start Thursday's preseason game on the road against Columbus, Dan Potash of SportsNet Pittsburgh reports.

rw.name: Jordan Binnington
rw.head: Patrolling home crease
rw.blurb: Binnington will guard the home crease in Thursday's preseason contest against the Blackhawks, per Lou Korac of NHL.com.

rw.name: Joonas Korpisalo
rw.head: First goalie off Thursday
rw.blurb: Korpisalo was the first goalie off during Thursday's morning skate, Colin Stephenson of Newsday reports, indicating that he'll draw the home preseason start against the Devils.

rw.name: Joseph Woll
rw.head: Between the pipes Thursday
rw.blurb: Woll will defend the home goal in Thursday's preseason contest against the Bruins, per Jordan Hall of NBC Sports Philadelphia.

rw.name: Alex Ovechkin
rw.head: Logs full practice Thursday
rw.blurb: Ovechkin (lower body) was a full participant in Thursday's practice and has a chance to play in Friday's preseason game against the Bruins, per Tom Gulitti of NHL.com.
